// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Phash&min=Phash&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests.Windows/Extensions/PhashTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Phash&min=Phash&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

// Verify.Phash: Compares image snapshots by perceptual hash, so a render that is perceptually equivalent still passes.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Phash
// Note: Windows only: the package targets net48 and net8.0-windows, and decodes images with
// System.Drawing.
// Note: Initialize() registers the comparer for png only, although the readme says png, jpg, bmp
// and tiff.
// Note: There is no parameterless RegisterComparer(). The extension argument is required, for
// example VerifyPhash.RegisterComparer("jpg") in the module initializer.
// Note: RegisterComparer also takes threshold, sigma, gamma and angles, so a second extension can
// be registered with its own tuning.
// Note: It writes no new snapshot target, so nothing changes about what is committed.
// Note: Verify's own VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng() solves the same problem without a package,
// and only one image comparer can be in effect.
public class PhashTests
{
    // This registers a comparer, not a converter, so the snapshot is an ordinary .verified.png.
    // What changes is the comparison: a re-render whose bytes differ, because of antialiasing or
    // a font hinting change, still passes while it looks the same.
    [Fact]
    public Task Png()
    {
        return Verify(BuildImage(), "png");
    }

    // Stands in for whatever the test renders. It is drawn in code so the samples need no
    // fixture file. System.Drawing is why this extension is Windows only.
    static MemoryStream BuildImage()
    {
        var stream = new MemoryStream();
        using (var bitmap = new Bitmap(120, 120))
        {
            using (var graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap))
            {
                graphics.Clear(Color.CornflowerBlue);
                graphics.FillEllipse(Brushes.White, 20, 20, 80, 80);
            }

            bitmap.Save(stream, ImageFormat.Png);
        }

        stream.Position = 0;
        return stream;
    }
}
